The '''deepwater Dac pie''' was a type of [[Pie/Legends|pie]]. It was often cooked during the [[Dantooine Spring Abundance Festival|Spring Abundance Festival]] on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="TOR:PfaD" />
